previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: John, a homeless man with hypertension, was admitted after being found unable to walk, intoxicated, and in atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rate. His heart rate was controlled with IV diltiazem and amiodarone, then transitioned to oral diltiazem and metoprolol. He was treated for alcohol withdrawal with thiamine, IV fluids, and CIWA-guided diazepam. Chest pain was determined non-cardiac, likely musculoskeletal, and dysuria was noted with a pending urine culture. He improved neurologically and was able to walk unassisted. Despite medical advice and warnings about risks of leaving, including seizures or recurrent arrhythmia, he chose to leave against medical advice on hospital day two to retrieve his belongings. He was instructed to return to the ER if symptoms worsened.
